effect_description_eng:
[Your Turn] For each Digimon card in this Digimon's digivolution cards with [Greymon] in its name (other than [DoruGreymon], [BurningGreymon] or [DexDoruGreymon]) or [Hybrid] trait, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[On Deletion] You may play 1 red level 4 or below Digimon card with the [Hybrid] trait from your hand without paying its cost.
